about: The screen groups of the hub, in the order a person meets them. Each group's screens live in its file, in the order shown. See design/hub/README.md for the <screen> format.

groups.title: Welcome
groups.intro: The same sign-in as Journey. If Journey is already on the phone, one tap and you're in: it is the same account.

groups.title: Set up a circle
groups.intro: A circle is the people you share with: a family, a couple, housemates or friends. Two minutes from sign-in to a Home that already has something in it.

groups.title: Home
groups.intro: The top row is where things live: Today, Plan, Notes, Library, Money and the Vault, one tap apart. The bottom bar is the same shape as Journey's: Home, People, +, Activity, You.

groups.title: People and sharing
groups.intro: Everything starts as yours alone. A small chip on every page, photo, bill and password says who can see it, and one sheet changes that.

groups.title: Notes
groups.intro: Spaces hold folders, folders hold folders and pages. A page can hold a live checklist, a bill, a sheet or a password, and a template can do real work.

groups.title: Library
groups.intro: Every photo, video and document, from everyone, on one wall. Pinch from days to years, look by person or place, and let a day at the lake gather itself.

groups.title: Plan
groups.intro: One calendar for events, reminders and bills. Type a sentence to add something; ask someone to do a job; watch a goal fill up.

groups.title: Money
groups.intro: Bills that remember themselves, and sheets that do the maths: a spreadsheet you fill in as cards on a phone, with formulas you can read.

groups.title: Vault
groups.intro: Passwords, cards, IDs and door codes, scrambled on the phone before they leave it. Share one so someone can use it without ever seeing it.

groups.title: With Journey
groups.intro: Journey is the story you tell; this is where the family keeps it. Keep a finished journey as a book, turn an album into a journey, and let a trip plan here and be told there.

groups.title: Activity
groups.intro: One calm inbox for a busy household: who added what, what is due, and who is asking for something. A Sunday summary instead of a stream of pings.

groups.title: You
groups.intro: Your circles, your storage, your security, and a plain way out with everything you brought.

groups.title: States
groups.intro: Loading, offline and brand new: every state says what is happening and what you can do next.

groups.title: Jot
groups.intro: Adding something without opening the app: widgets on the Home Screen, a note pinned in your notifications that you type into again and again, your voice, and the share button of any other app. Whatever you jot is read and filed for you.

groups.title: Keepsakes
groups.intro: More like the time capsule: templates that keep what a family would otherwise lose. What the children said, how tall they were, the stories only Grandma knows.

groups.title: Fair and fun
groups.intro: More like the chore wheel: small things that settle an argument, teach something, or make an ordinary week a bit lighter.
